title: Michuu Hin Raafamne Yaali Warqee Keessatti
intro: Gaaddidduu raajii guddaa tokkoo keessatti lubbuun dubbii dandeettii fi amantii ergama siidaa ta’e tokko gargaaruuf filatamte. Lakkoofsi kun yeroo ummanni bal’aan raafamu jabeessee dhaabbate, irra daddarbaa ifatti mul’atu kan wiirtuu waaqa tokkicha amantii balaadhaaf saaxilu lallabe. Raajichi kufaatii ummataa arguuf yeroo deebi'u ittisi lakkoofsi kun kan balleessaa osoo hin taane kan dirqamaa fi sodaa qoqqoodinsa ture. Gabricha Rabbii of kenne kun eenyu?
clues: Kan biraa cinatti dirqama qulqulluuf Rabbiin filadhe, gaheen koos kan deggersaa fi labsuu ture.
Dubbiin ifa ta’e naaf kenname, ergamaa tokko waliinis cunqursaa humna guddaa qabu tokko waliin wal dura dhaabbadhe.
Imala murteessaa tokko keessatti ergamaan sun kophaa isaa gaara tokkotti ol bahee, namoota akkan eegu na dhiise.
Bakka isaan hin jirretti namoonni sun fakkii warqee tolchanii kan hojjetan siʼa taʼu, amanamoo taʼanii akka jiraatan isaan kadhadheera, isaan garuu gorsa koo didan.
Ergamaan sun aarii fi gaddaan guutamee yeroo deebi’u, na qabame, garuu akkan mo’amee fi isaan gidduutti wal dhabdee uumuun sodaadhe jedheen ibse.
Ani raajii obboleessa koo Muusaa cinaa dhaabadhee ba’aa isaa qooddadhee waaqeffannaa waaqa tolfamaa irratti jabaatee turedha.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Namoonni akeekkachiisa kennanis re'ee warqee waaqeffatu turan
Namoonni ibidda boba'aa keessa na darbatan
trial.answer: Namoonni akeekkachiisa kennanis re'ee warqee waaqeffatu turan

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Bilisa ta'ee ergama raajii koo itti fufe
Saba haaraan akkan qajeelchu naaf kenname
Lubbuun jiraadhee gara samiitti ol fudhatame
Mootummaa tokko irratti bulchaa nan godhame
outcome.answer: Bilisa ta'ee ergama raajii koo itti fufe

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
